generator: PuffWorld20Hz + SensorField20Hz + TeachDetector saved1Hz fixed snapshot300 + actual gas/flow capture stages; constant emissions from0; measured BG never plume-corrected
route_limit: Recorded inlet moves on a straight line at at most3m/s from depot(0,0,2) after300 to one of(0,100,35)/(120,100,35), arrival ceiling to whole second; excludes field autopilot acceleration/obstacle route/body-to-inlet offset
emission_domain: Uniform support over six singles and fifteen pairs; wind U(240,300)deg/U(2,5)m/s; per-source SO2 logU(.25,50)g/s; CO2=SO2*1000*logU(.5,2); constant from run0
coverage_domain: Coverage conditional on the same NO_SIGNAL eligibility gate; all attempts including generation exceptions of unknown eligibility are retained separately. Raw true-support compatibility and final NOT_NEEDED-filtered survivors are distinct.
rank_rule: min(m,ceil(.95*(m+1))); every eligible failed fit retained as infinity
coverage_limit: 60 eligible independent synthetic episodes only; raw cutoff compatibility is not final-survivor coverage, physical validation or an SC1-domain guarantee. SC1 ratio25 is outside500..2000. Straight-line calibration routes omit actual autopilot geometry/body offsets.
